' Four arithmetic operations, Nomalization, Baseline correction, Smoothing, Derivative, Time- temperature 'conversion, Fourier transform, Kubelka Munk conversion, ATR correction, Atmosphere correcti on. ' Should have builrin program function to supporl confirmation test quantitation, contaminant analysis 16. Quantitative Mode: Spectrum search. Peak search, Combination search, Instrument should be provided with a standard Library of approx. 30,000 spectra or more as standard 17. ATRAccessory: ATR should have a monolithic diamond ATR workable for the range of 7,800 cm-r to 350 cm I. Should have the facility of a utomatic self-recognition in software with a pressure arrn. 18. Sample type: Solids, liquids, powders, coated material, nano rnaterial paste, thin film, gel, polymer, etc. 19. Accessories for variable temperature application (VT): Module fbr variable Temperature Cell Holder, complete with temperature controller and NaCl windows over the range from -190"C to 250oC, should be compatible with FT-lR instrument for application of Polymerization study, Phase transition studies, reaction kinetics, polymorphism, catalysis, oxidation studies, etc. 20. Sample Cells: One No. CaF: material-based cell. Spacers fbr the liquid cell. 21. KBr Pellet accessories: KBr Pellet accessories with hydraulic press, Mortaq Pestle, etc., for preparation of KBr pellets (manual). 22. Installation and User training: Free of Cost with sufficient on-site training on the detailed application 23. Humidity: Should be able to withstand hurnidity levels 20 to 90 percent RH without any condensation; humidity indicator with dehumidifier

unit. 24.PC and accessories: i7 l2th Gen Intel Processor, ACg RAM; ITB SSD, 24 lnch Monitor with a Win l0 Pro Licensed Operating Systern, and a Co mpatible Printer with scanning facility. 25. Terms and Conditions: The offered system must strictly comply with all technical specifications mentioned in the tender document . Any deviation from the specified requirements must be clearly indicated in a separate Compliance/Deviation Statement. . Failure to submit such a statement may result in rejection of the bid. o During technical evaluation, bidders may be required to provide an on-site demonstration of the quoted system, if deemed necessary by the institute, without any additional cost. o No essential accessory required for standard operation or performance testing of the system shall be quoted as optional at the time of biddi ng. o The FTIR software must be supplied with a perpetual (non-subscription) license with upgrade support for a minimum period of ten (10) years from the date of installation. o ln case a subscription-based license is offered, the bidder must provide a fully upgradable license valid for ten (10) years at no additional co st. o Complete installation, commissioning, and on-site user training shall be carried out free of cost. o Training shall include hands-on operation, routine maintenance, data analysis, and application-specific demonstrations relevant to materials , polymers, nano-materials, and chemical analysis. o The system must be covered by a comprehensive on-site warranty of a minimum of three (3) years for h ardware, including all parts and lab our. Software support and upgrades must be provided for a minimum period of ten (10) years. o The warranty shall include preventive maintenance visits and breakdown support. o The maximum response time for attending service calls shall not exceed twelve (12) working days from the date of complaint o ' The bidder must submit an undertaking confirming the availability of service support and spares for at l east ten (10) years after installatio n. o The instrument shall be subiected to acceptance testing after installation to verify all specified perform ance parameters. o Successful demonstration of performance is mandatory for final acceptance of the system. o The supplier shall provide the following documents at the time of installation: o User manuals and service manuals (hard copy and soft copy) o Calibration certificates o Installation and training completion report Payment shall be released as per institutional/government norms after successful installation. commissioning. and acceptance of the system.
